vector-instruction-audit.contract: Exact payload ELFs and scalar reference disassembly prove required opcodes/widths, preserved-register critical windows, no accidental optional instruction in dispatch and no auto-vectorization or contraction in independent scalar references.

vector-kernel-opcode-audit.contract: Pinned disassembler decodes all selected McKernel executable sections and unchanged three host modules; unexpected vector/x87/MMX operations rejected, only exact reviewed FP-management instruction ranges allowed.

vector-local-signals.contract: Real in-McKernel self/thread-directed delivery and locally nested handlers verified; handler clobber and interrupted-state restoration observed with raw assembly. External forwarding remains a separate blocked capability.
vector-local-signals.evidence_scope: No broad execution capability is accepted by the drafting release.

vector-runtime-discovery.contract: Baseline-generic CPUID leaf0/1/7/0xD and guarded XGETBV(0) captured separately in pinned Linux guest and McKernel; feature masks and enabled xstate offsets/sizes independently checked. No optional instruction before both-engine gate.
vector-runtime-discovery.evidence_scope: No broad execution capability is accepted by the drafting release.
